Jobs at the University of St Andrews

Our people are our most valued asset and we are delighted that you are considering applying for a position with us.

From this page you can:
  • manage your job search for a future career with our world-leading university
  • register your details, search and apply for live vacancies
  • sign up for vacancy alerts relevant to your field of interest
Please note that the application deadline for all vacancies is midnight GMT on the closing date.
Register for a Vacancy Alert
If there aren't any suitable vacancies for you at the moment you can sign up for a vacancy alert and receive notifications when appropriate vacancies become available.
Register your details for casual employment opportunities
On occasion the University requires staff to cover short periods of employment (up to 3 months). Positions available are normally of a clerical nature. If you are currently available for casual employment please click on the button and complete the casual clerical register form, specifying the areas of work in which you would be interested in.
